summary: Enhance your skills with our Agile Scrum Master Training Course. Learn essential methodologies and lead teams to success in a dynamic environment.
lede: Scrum Master training covers how to facilitate iterative delivery and support self-managing teams. It is for Scrum Masters, agile coaches, product owners, and delivery or project managers who guide product development and team performance. Through practical exercises, learners refine and prioritize backlogs, plan sprints, facilitate Scrum events, resolve impediments, and use flow measures and dashboards to track work.
audienceIntro: This program is engineered for professionals responsible for driving agile delivery, facilitating team performance, and managing product development lifecycles within complex organizational structures.
modules: Sprint Execution and The Daily Scrum
Sprint Review and The Definition of Done
Agile Metrics, Tracking, and Team Dashboards
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of software development lifecycles or project management principles. Prior exposure to agile concepts or experience working in a product delivery team is highly recommended. No programming experience is required, but familiarity with digital collaboration tools like Jira, Azure DevOps or Confluence will be beneficial.
